title: Executive Assistant
description:
Elite Executive Assistant to CEO For U.S. Online Brand

Full-Time | Remote | Working U.S. Central Hours | Work Directly with the Founder


We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to Austin Netzley, CEO of 2X.


This is not a typical assistant role.


This is for someone who wants to operate as a true right hand to a founder — helping build, organize, and execute across both business and life.


If you love systems, execution, speed, and turning chaos into clarity, this role will be incredibly rewarding.


About 2X &

At 2X (2X.co), we help founders scale their businesses while getting their time back. We have coaching programs, online community, and in-person events. 


At , we help small businesses implement the proven systems and strategies to optimize their team and operations so they can scale faster with more freedom. 


We focus on building businesses that:

- Run on systems (not the founder)

- Scale with more profit and less complexity

- Create real freedom and long-term value


We move fast, operate at a high standard, and care deeply about doing meaningful work that impacts entrepreneurs and their families. 


The Mission of This Role

Your mission is simple:


Protect and free up the CEO’s time as a right hand partner to help handle a lot of the details and tasks that can bog him down. 


You will operate as a leverage multiplier — ensuring the right things get done, at the right time, with high quality.


This role is about ownership, anticipation, and execution… with a strong attention to detail, a love for systems, producing efficiently, and being able to wear numerous hats with different tasks and responsibilities. 


The Outcomes You Own

This role is responsible for ensuring:


1. CEO Time is Protected and Optimized

Calendar reflects true priorities, not noise.


2. Communication is Clean and Controlled

Email, Slack, and external communication are organized, timely, and proactive.


3. Projects Move Without Bottlenecks

Key initiatives progress quickly without the CEO needing to follow up.


4. Personal + Business Logistics Run Seamlessly

Travel, scheduling, events, and life logistics are handled smoothly.


5. Events Are Executed at a High Level

Masterminds and experiences are well-organized and on-brand.


6. The Team Stays Aligned and Supported

Basic HR, onboarding, and internal coordination run cleanly.


7. Systems Are Built (Not Just Tasks Completed)

Work becomes organized, repeatable, and scalable over time.


Core Responsibilities


1. Executive Support (Business)

  • Own email + communication flow
  • Manage calendar with strong prioritization
  • Coordinate business travel and logistics
  • Conduct research and prep materials
  • Support slides, docs, and key initiatives
  • Maintain ClickUp task organization


2. Personal Support

  • Plan and coordinate personal travel
  • Schedule personal appointments and events
  • Manage gifts and special occasions
  • Handle health, insurance, and admin logistics
  • Coordinate with household support


3. Event Coordination (Masterminds)

  • Coordinate venues, food, and activities
  • Manage communication with clients, vendors, and speakers
  • Support on-site execution (when applicable)
  • Maintain event systems and checklists


  • 4. Team & HR Support
  • Support team communication and culture
  • Track reports, scorecards, and metrics
  • Coordinate onboarding and access for new hires
  • Manage team gifts, time off, and logistics
  • Assist with hiring and screening when needed


5. Marketing & Founder Support (Light)

  • Coordinate with media team as needed
  • Support social posting or content logistics
  • Assist with podcast and PR coordination


The Ideal Candidate

You are not just organized — you are operationally sharp.


You likely:

  • Learn fast and figure things out without hand-holding
  • Are extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Execute quickly while maintaining quality
  • Anticipate needs before being told
  • Take full ownership of outcomes
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Are tech-savvy and comfortable with tools
  • Use AI tools to increase speed and output
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-performance environments


You are the type of person who:

Sees something messy → fixes it → systemizes it → improves it.


What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Within your first 60–90 days:

- CEO calendar is always clean, structured, and optimized

- Communication is streamlined and proactive

- Travel and logistics run smoothly without friction

- Key projects are moving forward without bottlenecks

- Event systems are organized and ready for execution

- Core workflows are documented and improving


Why This Role Is Different

Direct access to the founder

- You’ll work side-by-side with the CEO on real decisions and execution.


High ownership, not task-taking

- You are expected to think, improve, and operate — not just follow instructions.


Massive learning curve

- You’ll see how a high-performing founder operates across business and life.


Variety + speed

- No two weeks look the same — this role touches everything.


Opportunity to grow


Logistics

  • Location: Remote position
  • Hours: 40 hours/week
  • Compensation: based on experience and skills 


We are looking for a long-term fit only. There will be numerous opportunities to advance into other roles if you desire, but this EA role is ideally a long-term position for you.


How to Apply

If you’re someone who wants to operate as a true right hand — and take ownership in a fast-moving environment — we’d love to hear from you.


Apply with:

  • Your resume
  • A short paragraph or few lines on why this role excites you
  • Your email address 


We’ll then review and be in touch!

title: Consultor(a) Logística - Break Bulk e CNTR
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú



O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil



No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Atuação:


Cidade de Santos/SP



Desafio:



Suporte direto na criação no Plano de estivagem, melhoria contínua e multiplicação e treinamento do time operacional.



Principais Atividades:



  • Operacionalizar os procedimentos do terminal
  • Apoiar no desenho operacional dos processos (equipamentos, recebimento de carga, armazenagem e embarque)
  • Oferecer suporte técnico e expertise em e novos projetos e estudos de viabilidade do terminal.
  • Criar e revisar o Plano de Estivagem (Tier Pattern) e plano de carga da celulose, otimizando a distribuição, volume e segregação por destino e tipo de carga, em conformidade com as restrições navais e regulamentares.
  • Assegurar o alinhamento e a aprovação técnica do plano junto ao Port Captain e ao Comando do Navio antes do início da operação.
  • Fornecer suporte e alinhamento full-time ao time de embarque no cais (incluindo guincheiros, sinaleiros e trabalhadores de porão), resolvendo dúvidas técnicas sobre o plano de carga e garantindo a correta execução da estivagem.
  • Treinar e multiplicar o conhecimento sobre padrões de estivagem, sequenciamento de carga e manuseio da celulose para toda a equipe operacional, visando a padronização, redução de avarias e aumento de produtividade
  • Conduzir a melhoria contínua dos processos de embarque e estivagem, propondo ajustes nos Tier Patterns e nos procedimentos para maximizar a taxa de produtividade

description:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.

  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

title: UX Writer Curador(a) de IA Conversacional (Chatbot)
description:
Na InBot, curadoria é um trabalho contínuo de evolução do assistente virtual: olhar o que está acontecendo na operação, identificar oportunidades reais de melhoria (com evidências) e transformar isso em ajustes e melhorias que aumentam qualidade, clareza e resolução.


Estamos abrindo uma vaga dedicada para Curadoria, com foco total nessa frente. A pessoa precisa ter experiência como UX Writer em chatbot, porque aqui a curadoria envolve leitura de contexto, decisão conversacional, priorização e diálogo com cliente.


Mais sobre nós: 


Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Garantir a qualidade e evolução contínua dos assistentes virtuais, acompanhando performance, identificando fricções e conduzindo um ciclo recorrente de melhorias alinhadas com cliente e time interno.


Você vai atuar como responsável pela curadoria ponta a ponta, incluindo:


  • Acompanhar a operação do assistente virtual no dia a dia
  • Identificar dúvidas recorrentes, respostas ruins, lacunas de conteúdo e fricções de conversa
  • Propor ajustes de conteúdo e melhorias no comportamento do bot
  • Analisar feedbacks e sinais de experiência do usuário
  • Entender o “porquê” de insatisfações e queda de satisfação
  • Transformar isso em ações práticas de melhoria
  • ⁠Acompanhar performance de jornadas e fluxos
  • Mapear abandono, confusão, etapas críticas e oportunidades de simplificação
  • Propor ajustes de texto, ordem, clareza e estrutura do fluxo
  • ⁠Acompanhar integrações e impactos na experiência (em parceria com dev)
  • Monitorar a saúde das integrações via relatório de APIs, identificando sinais de instabilidade que impactem a jornada (ex.: aumento de falhas acima do padrão ou queda de sucesso). Ao detectar anomalias, o UX registra o impacto percebido na experiência e aciona o time de desenvolvimento para análise técnica e resolução.
  • Analisar atendimentos humanos para mapear oportunidades de automação
  • identificar temas que podem virar conteúdo, comportamento do bot ou novas jornadas
  • ⁠Conduzir o ciclo de melhoria com o cliente
  • Organizar achados e evidências
  • Apresentar recomendações e priorização
  • Alinhar o que vira execução interna vs o que exige alinhamento/decisão do cliente (e quando aplicável, encaminhamento comercial)


Ritmo de trabalho (cronograma):


  • O trabalho acontece em um ciclo contínuo, com cadências claras:
  • Diário/contínuo: acompanhamento da operação, identificação de fricções e melhorias
  • Quinzenal: análise de atendimentos humanos para oportunidades de automação
  • Mensal: apresentação consolidada de sugestões e prioridades para o cliente
  • Trimestral (para projetos médios/grandes): avaliação mais profunda de boas práticas e experiência, em formato de comitê com UX e liderança

    • Requisitos e qualificações

    Requisitos:


    • Experiência comprovada como UX Writer em chatbots/assistentes virtuais
    • Boa leitura de contexto conversacional e capacidade de propor melhorias objetivas
    • ⁠⁠Organização e disciplina para lidar com volume e manter cadência de acompanhamento
    • Segurança para conversar com cliente: explicar achados, defender recomendações e alinhar prioridades


    Diferenciais:


    • Experiência com análise de dados de jornada (funil, abandono, eventos)
    • Familiaridade com integrações/APIs (mesmo sem codar)
    • Boas práticas conversacionais em multicanais

    • Informações adicionais
    • Contrato PJ + cartão Flash (vale alimentação/refeição).
    • Modelo de trabalho: híbrido – até 3x por semana presencial (região da Paulista – SP)
    • Contrato PJ (MEI ou ME)
    • Notebook e celular próprios
    • Projetos desafiadores e inovadores, com tecnologia de ponta em IA conversacional.
    • Ambiente colaborativo, que valoriza autonomia, criatividade e foco em resultado.

title: Business developer & parcerias estratégicas
description:
Venha fazer parte da Velana
Estamos em busca de um(a) Business Developer & Parcerias Estratégicas com perfil estratégico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.
Essa posição envolve desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas e prospecção ativa de leads (outbound), contribuindo diretamente para a expansão da Velana no ecossistema de pagamentos digitais. Buscamos alguém que já tenha vivência com gateways de pagamento, seja proativo e consiga identificar oportunidades de alto valor tanto em parcerias quanto em contas potenciais.
Sobre a Velana
A Velana é um gateway de pagamentos digital em crescimento acelerado, conectando e-commerces, plataformas e infoprodutores a soluções de pagamento seguras, eficientes e escaláveis.
Nossa expansão acontece através de tecnologia, estratégia comercial e desenvolvimento de parcerias relevantes dentro do ecossistema de pagamentos digitais.
Principais Responsabilidades
Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio e parcerias estratégicas;
Realizar prospecção ativa (outbound) de leads qualificados;
Prospectar e-commerces, plataformas digitais, infoprodutores e parceiros estratégicos para integração com o gateway Velana;
Desenvolver e estruturar parcerias comerciais e canais de aquisição;
Atuar de forma consultiva apresentando soluções de gateway de pagamento e processamento financeiro;
Analisar mercado, concorrência e tendências dentro do setor de pagamentos digitais e fintechs;
Gerar oportunidades qualificadas para o time comercial;
Registrar e acompanhar oportunidades no CRM;
Trabalhar em conjunto com Vendas, Produto e Marketing para fortalecer a estratégia de expansão. Requisitos Essenciais
Experiência em Business Development, Parcerias e Prospecção Comercial (outbound);
Experiência com gateways de pagamento, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
Comunicação clara e habilidade de relacionamento com decisores (CEOs, Founders, Heads);
Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a oportunidades;
Organização, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma. Diferenciais
Experiência prévia atuando em gateways de pagamento, subadquirentes ou adquirentes;
Networking dentro do ecossistema de plataformas, produtores digitais e e-commerces;
Conhecimento em integrações de pagamento, APIs ou soluções financeiras digitais. O que oferecemos
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para crescimento;
Contato direto com a liderança e participação ativa na expansão da empresa;
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional dentro de um mercado em forte crescimento;
Cultura voltada para resultado, colaboração e construção de longo prazo. Por que a Velana?
A Velana está em um momento estratégico de expansão, construindo um ecossistema sólido dentro do mercado de pagamentos digitais. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de participar ativamente da construção de novas parcerias, abertura de mercados e crescimento da empresa.
Buscamos pessoas que queiram construir junto, assumir protagonismo e fazer parte de um projeto em crescimento acelerado dentro do universo fintech.

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.
O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.

Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.

Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.

Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.

Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).

title: Media buyer
description:
Senior Media Buyer – Home Renovation / Roofing (Video-First)
Location
Remote
Full-time
About Us
We're a lean, A1 performance marketing team serving 30+ roofing contractors across the U. S., and we're scaling aggressively to 100+ clients.
No bloated layers. No politics. No babysitting.
We specialize in video-driven paid media systems that generate booked appointments and signed jobs for roofing and home renovation businesses. If you don't understand contractors, sales cycles, and how to turn ads into revenue — this is not the role for you.
If you do — you'll have autonomy, trust, and real impact.
The Role (Read Carefully)
We're hiring a Senior Media Buyer who can own campaign execution end-to-end for roofing and home renovation clients.
This is not a "strategy-only" role.
This is not a "just launch ads and wait" role.
You will:
Set up
Launch
Optimize
Scale Video-first paid media systems across TOF / MOF / BOF.
You must understand how contractors think, how homeowners buy, and how to turn attention into booked jobs.
Core Responsibilities
1. Campaign Setup & Launch
Build and launch Meta (Facebook/Instagram) video campaigns for roofing & home renovation clients
Structure accounts cleanly (TOF / MOF / BOF separation)
Implement proper tracking, events, and reporting
QA everything before launch — no sloppy work 2. Funnel Ownership (TOF → MOF → BOF)
You must know how to:
Run TOF video ads for awareness and demand creation
Build MOF retargeting (video views, engagement, site traffic)
Execute BOF conversion campaigns (lead forms, landing pages, booked calls)
Diagnose where funnels break and fix them fast 3. Video Ad Performance Optimization
Analyze hooks, angles, creatives, and messaging
Kill losers fast, scale winners responsibly
Give clear feedback on what video content is needed to improve results
Understand what works specifically in roofing & home renovation 4. Client Readiness & Professional Conduct
You don't talk like a marketer — you talk like a business operator
Campaign updates are clear, calm, and confident
You understand contractor economics (job size, close rates, seasonality)
You protect the agency's reputation at all times Required Experience (Non-Negotiable)
You must have:
3+ years managing paid social campaigns
Direct experience in home renovation or roofing marketing
Proven results using video ads (Meta primarily)
Experience running full-funnel paid media systems
Strong understanding of lead quality, not just CPL
Ability to work independently without hand-holding If you've never marketed roofing, remodeling, windows, HVAC, solar, or similar trades — don't apply.
Who You Are
Tactical, fast, and detail-oriented
Calm under pressure
Takes ownership and responsibility
Doesn't make excuses — fixes problems
Understands that performance > opinions
Wants to grow with a team scaling hard This Role Is NOT For You If:
You need constant direction
You blame platforms instead of fixing campaigns
You don't understand contractors or local service businesses
You want a "chill" role instead of a high-performance one Compensation
Competitive base pay (based on experience)
Performance-based growth opportunities
Long-term role as we scale to 100+ clients
High performers will be rewarded. Period.

It's ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.

Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.

Automation: Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications

Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction

Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:

We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.

• Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).

Experience

title: Full-time social ads specialist
description:
About Us
Blue Tuskr is a U. S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.
What You'll Do
As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.
Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to Linked In, Pinterest, and Tik Tok.
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.
This role requires a strong understanding of post-i OS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.
More specifically, in this role you will:
Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates What We're Looking For
4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships What This Role Is NOT
This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.
Time Commitment
Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.
Pay
$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.
If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo.
Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.
Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!
About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.
We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications:
Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience:
Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:
Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms. Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world? Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We're looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you'll do..
As an Account Manager, you'll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who've already shown interest
Understand what they're building, why it matters, and where they're stuck
Clearly position Oneday's programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates This is not a passive customer success role.
It's a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You'll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results What you'll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Outbound call center operator (customer care) – hvac industry remote position – based in brazil | serving u.s. customers
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.
The primary goal of this position is to generate service demand and maintain a steady flow of scheduled appointments for field technicians. By contacting existing and past customers, the operator helps prevent equipment breakdowns and ensures customers receive reliable comfort in their homes.
Success in this role means consistently scheduling maintenance visits, delivering a positive customer experience, and maintaining accurate CRM records. This position is an important part of the company's customer care and service operations, directly supporting the productivity of field technicians.
Responsibilities
• Make outbound calls to customers in the company database to schedule HVAC maintenance visits and inspections.
• Contact different customer groups including Comfort Club members, inactive customers, and new prospects.
• Present the company's preventive maintenance offers and service guarantees clearly and professionally.
• Schedule appointments for HVAC tune-ups and inspections according to technician availability.
• Conduct customer satisfaction follow-up calls (\"Happy Calls\") after service visits.
• Record call outcomes, customer information, and appointment details in the CRM system.
• Follow company call scripts and communication guidelines to maintain consistency and professionalism.
• Maintain productivity targets related to calls made and appointments scheduled.
• Coordinate with the scheduling and dispatch teams when necessary to ensure accurate appointment management.
• Maintain a positive and professional tone during all customer interactions.
Qualifications
Skills
• Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).
• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
• Ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive attitude during outbound calls.
• Strong organization and time management skills.
• Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, and scheduling tools.
• Fast and accurate typing skills.
Experience
• Previous experience in customer service, sales, telemarketing, or call center environments is preferred.
• Experience with outbound calling or appointment setting is a strong advantage.
• Experience working with U. S. customers or international support teams is a plus.
Work Requirements
• Quiet and professional home office environment.
• Reliable high-speed internet connection.
• Ability to work during U. S. business hours.
• Strong focus and discipline during outbound calling periods.

title: Data analyst v
description:

Visão Geral da Posição
A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.
O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.
O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.
O que você fará
Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics. Qualificações Mínimas
Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis
Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark).
Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Senior java software engineer

description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE
Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4 HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).

Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. SELECTION CRITERIA
Essential:
Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
Experience in S/4 HANA environment and Fiori applications.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline Desirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.

Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.

title: Remote ai quality analyst (japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Key Qualifications:
Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description:
In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience:
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Business development manager/director
description:
Ping Pong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300 B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world's leading cross-border platforms – and we're just getting started.
Ping Pong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.
Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.
WHAT' S THE CHALLENGE?
You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You'll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You've got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.
WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH
You'll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You'll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next. WHAT YOU BRING
Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams. WHO YOU ARE
Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
Customer-focused, you can't imagine working in any other way, and it's the only way to achieve our goals.
Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders Ping Pong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

title: Senior full-stack mobile engineer (react native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native i OS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.
Fly Me Out is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.
We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.
What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, Type Script, Tan Stack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/Type Script backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.
Day to day, you'll be working on things like:
Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with Type Script
Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction Compensation & Terms
This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.
Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)
Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)
Health benefits: Not offered at this stage
Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis
Probation: 2 weeks
Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil
How to Apply
Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Software engineer sênior - vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico

Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems What we are looking for:Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.
Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment What we offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our " Get Together" where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)

Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing
Progress: every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!
