title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development
Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.
Location: Brazil
The Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M& A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M& A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.
The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M& A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.
Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M& A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M& A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M& A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M& A leadership to qualify M& A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units. Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M& A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M& A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency. Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.
Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!
Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:
O Grupo Capital:
Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.
Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.
Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.
Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital:
A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.
Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.
Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.
Responsabilidades:
Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. Pré-requisitos:
Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
Proatividade orientada a resultados;
Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Diferencial:
Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas. Você terá:
Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
Programa de partnership estruturado;
Treinamentos exclusivos;
Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente. Modo de contratação:
Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Wordpress plugin & full stack developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.
Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?
Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution: Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.
Defect Management: Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
Collaboration: Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.
Automation: Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines. Compensation
Salary: based on your experience level

Current resume
Synopsis of recent salary history

Remote

title: Graphic designer
description:
Company DescriptionEMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now Saa S products.
We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.
We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here. You Are
An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.
You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and Saa S-oriented design work. Role Description
This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.
You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing Saa S initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.
Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.
Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders. Responsibilities
Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
Support video and social content with strong visual design
Contribute to UX/UI design for Saa S and internal software products
Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction Qualifications
Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
Attention to detail and strong design judgment
Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
Fluent in English, written and spoken

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.
Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Helbor Empreendimentos S. A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3, a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.
A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia. Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal. Informações adicionais

Vale Alimentação

About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Data analyst & operations manager
description:
Data Analyst & Operations Manager
We're looking for a motivated data driven person who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. This position is available remote in Brazil.
You solve problems by connecting your holistic business knowledge, marketing understanding and deep dive analytical abilities
You are our truffle hunter, who quickly finds smart and pragmatic ways through complex datasets and recognises patterns in business KPIs and marketing channels
You autonomously realize projects in cooperation with other colleagues as well as with marketing channels which serve the management as a strategic decision-making basis for growth and excellence
You filter growth relevant information from our BI/tracking systems and convert complexity into simplicity
You find strategies to automate marketing campaigns, improve targeting and drive marketing efficiency
You monitor business relevant KPIs on a regular basis and find new ways for automated reporting systems
You monitor business supply chain on a regular basis to ensure our stock is up to our potential sales
Degree in Engineering, TI, Business Informatics, Economics, Statistics, Data Science or similar
Strong analytical skills: able to break down problems, test hypotheses, track the impact of solutions on the respective problems.
Great experience with tools such as Excel and Power BI or similar
Know-how in Google Analytics is nice to have
Know-how in Facebook Ads is nice to have
Know-how in segmentation is nice to have
Fluent in English and Portuguese; every other European language is a plus
You have an impact. With innovation and smart technology, we create comfy sustainable shoes and digital assets for the future generations. We want your ideas and give you autonomy to make them reality.
At Undo For Tomorrow we are flexible. Organize your own schedule, and balance work between the office and home as it's best for you. We give you trust-based hours and a flexible smart working policy.
Teamwork makes the dream work. Our team has people from 3 different continents. We work in a multicultural environment where we can challenge and support each other.
We're building for the long term, and that means protecting our planet. We constantly test new green technologies and new opportunities, both physical and digital. We are a Brazilian / European footwear startup with headquarters in Lisbon preparing to sell globally. We started not so long ago (2021) and we are growing fast with many challenges and new market opportunities to unlock.
We believe that innovation and technology allied to sustainability is key to success in one of the most competitive markets on the planet. Our goal is to bring comfort and well being to our growing community.
Our journey has just begun. Are you ready to join us and help shape the future?

title: Outbound call center operator (customer care) – hvac industry remote position – based in brazil | serving u.s. customers
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.
The primary goal of this position is to generate service demand and maintain a steady flow of scheduled appointments for field technicians. By contacting existing and past customers, the operator helps prevent equipment breakdowns and ensures customers receive reliable comfort in their homes.
Success in this role means consistently scheduling maintenance visits, delivering a positive customer experience, and maintaining accurate CRM records. This position is an important part of the company's customer care and service operations, directly supporting the productivity of field technicians.
Responsibilities
• Make outbound calls to customers in the company database to schedule HVAC maintenance visits and inspections.
• Contact different customer groups including Comfort Club members, inactive customers, and new prospects.
• Present the company's preventive maintenance offers and service guarantees clearly and professionally.
• Schedule appointments for HVAC tune-ups and inspections according to technician availability.
• Conduct customer satisfaction follow-up calls (\"Happy Calls\") after service visits.
• Record call outcomes, customer information, and appointment details in the CRM system.
• Follow company call scripts and communication guidelines to maintain consistency and professionalism.
• Maintain productivity targets related to calls made and appointments scheduled.
• Coordinate with the scheduling and dispatch teams when necessary to ensure accurate appointment management.
• Maintain a positive and professional tone during all customer interactions.
Qualifications
Skills
• Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).
• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
• Ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive attitude during outbound calls.
• Strong organization and time management skills.
• Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, and scheduling tools.
• Fast and accurate typing skills.
Experience
• Previous experience in customer service, sales, telemarketing, or call center environments is preferred.
• Experience with outbound calling or appointment setting is a strong advantage.
• Experience working with U. S. customers or international support teams is a plus.
Work Requirements
• Quiet and professional home office environment.
• Reliable high-speed internet connection.
• Ability to work during U. S. business hours.
• Strong focus and discipline during outbound calling periods.

description:
Senior Media Buyer – Home Renovation / Roofing (Video-First)
Location
Remote
Full-time

We're a lean, A1 performance marketing team serving 30+ roofing contractors across the U. S., and we're scaling aggressively to 100+ clients.
No bloated layers. No politics. No babysitting.
We specialize in video-driven paid media systems that generate booked appointments and signed jobs for roofing and home renovation businesses. If you don't understand contractors, sales cycles, and how to turn ads into revenue — this is not the role for you.

We're hiring a Senior Media Buyer who can own campaign execution end-to-end for roofing and home renovation clients.
This is not a "strategy-only" role.
This is not a "just launch ads and wait" role.
You will:
Set up
Launch
Optimize
Scale Video-first paid media systems across TOF / MOF / BOF.
You must understand how contractors think, how homeowners buy, and how to turn attention into booked jobs.

1. Campaign Setup & Launch
Build and launch Meta (Facebook/Instagram) video campaigns for roofing & home renovation clients
Structure accounts cleanly (TOF / MOF / BOF separation)
Implement proper tracking, events, and reporting
QA everything before launch — no sloppy work 2. Funnel Ownership (TOF → MOF → BOF)

Run TOF video ads for awareness and demand creation
Build MOF retargeting (video views, engagement, site traffic)
Execute BOF conversion campaigns (lead forms, landing pages, booked calls)
Diagnose where funnels break and fix them fast 3. Video Ad Performance Optimization
Analyze hooks, angles, creatives, and messaging
Kill losers fast, scale winners responsibly

Understand what works specifically in roofing & home renovation 4. Client Readiness & Professional Conduct
You don't talk like a marketer — you talk like a business operator
Campaign updates are clear, calm, and confident
You understand contractor economics (job size, close rates, seasonality)
You protect the agency's reputation at all times Required Experience (Non-Negotiable)

3+ years managing paid social campaigns
Direct experience in home renovation or roofing marketing
Proven results using video ads (Meta primarily)
Experience running full-funnel paid media systems
Strong understanding of lead quality, not just CPL
Ability to work independently without hand-holding If you've never marketed roofing, remodeling, windows, HVAC, solar, or similar trades — don't apply.
Who You Are
Tactical, fast, and detail-oriented
Calm under pressure
Takes ownership and responsibility
Doesn't make excuses — fixes problems
Understands that performance > opinions
Wants to grow with a team scaling hard This Role Is NOT For You If:
You need constant direction
You blame platforms instead of fixing campaigns
You don't understand contractors or local service businesses
You want a "chill" role instead of a high-performance one Compensation
Competitive base pay (based on experience)
Performance-based growth opportunities
Long-term role as we scale to 100+ clients
High performers will be rewarded. Period.

title: Data analyst & operations manager
description:
Data Analyst & Operations Manager
We're looking for a motivated data driven person who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. This position is available remote in Brazil.
You solve problems by connecting your holistic business knowledge, marketing understanding and deep dive analytical abilities
You are our truffle hunter, who quickly finds smart and pragmatic ways through complex datasets and recognises patterns in business KPIs and marketing channels
You autonomously realize projects in cooperation with other colleagues as well as with marketing channels which serve the management as a strategic decision-making basis for growth and excellence
You filter growth relevant information from our BI/tracking systems and convert complexity into simplicity
You find strategies to automate marketing campaigns, improve targeting and drive marketing efficiency
You monitor business relevant KPIs on a regular basis and find new ways for automated reporting systems
You monitor business supply chain on a regular basis to ensure our stock is up to our potential sales
Degree in Engineering, TI, Business Informatics, Economics, Statistics, Data Science or similar
Strong analytical skills: able to break down problems, test hypotheses, track the impact of solutions on the respective problems.
Great experience with tools such as Excel and Power BI or similar
Know-how in Google Analytics is nice to have
Know-how in Facebook Ads is nice to have
Know-how in segmentation is nice to have
Fluent in English and Portuguese; every other European language is a plus
You have an impact. With innovation and smart technology, we create comfy sustainable shoes and digital assets for the future generations. We want your ideas and give you autonomy to make them reality.
At Undo For Tomorrow we are flexible. Organize your own schedule, and balance work between the office and home as it's best for you. We give you trust-based hours and a flexible smart working policy.
Teamwork makes the dream work. Our team has people from 3 different continents. We work in a multicultural environment where we can challenge and support each other.
We're building for the long term, and that means protecting our planet. We constantly test new green technologies and new opportunities, both physical and digital. We are a Brazilian / European footwear startup with headquarters in Lisbon preparing to sell globally. We started not so long ago (2021) and we are growing fast with many challenges and new market opportunities to unlock.
We believe that innovation and technology allied to sustainability is key to success in one of the most competitive markets on the planet. Our goal is to bring comfort and well being to our growing community.
Our journey has just begun. Are you ready to join us and help shape the future?

title: Marketing & product designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at Project Mark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.
We're looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets
Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints. Help Center & Education Content
Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases. Marketing & Growth Design
Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently. Website & Conversion Optimization
Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind. Sales & Operations Enablement
Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed. Product Design Support
Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces. Asset Management & Brand Consistency
Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team. What We're Looking For
Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
Advanced or fluent English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications
Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience designing within a B2 B Saa S environment.
Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems. Nice-to-Have Skills
Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
Experience with Hub Spot (emails, templates, workflows).
Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.). Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Data analyst & operations manager
description:
Data Analyst & Operations Manager
We're looking for a motivated data driven person who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. This position is available remote in Brazil.
You solve problems by connecting your holistic business knowledge, marketing understanding and deep dive analytical abilities
You are our truffle hunter, who quickly finds smart and pragmatic ways through complex datasets and recognises patterns in business KPIs and marketing channels
You autonomously realize projects in cooperation with other colleagues as well as with marketing channels which serve the management as a strategic decision-making basis for growth and excellence
You filter growth relevant information from our BI/tracking systems and convert complexity into simplicity
You find strategies to automate marketing campaigns, improve targeting and drive marketing efficiency
You monitor business relevant KPIs on a regular basis and find new ways for automated reporting systems
You monitor business supply chain on a regular basis to ensure our stock is up to our potential sales
Degree in Engineering, TI, Business Informatics, Economics, Statistics, Data Science or similar
Strong analytical skills: able to break down problems, test hypotheses, track the impact of solutions on the respective problems.
Great experience with tools such as Excel and Power BI or similar
Know-how in Google Analytics is nice to have
Know-how in Facebook Ads is nice to have
Know-how in segmentation is nice to have
Fluent in English and Portuguese; every other European language is a plus
You have an impact. With innovation and smart technology, we create comfy sustainable shoes and digital assets for the future generations. We want your ideas and give you autonomy to make them reality.
At Undo For Tomorrow we are flexible. Organize your own schedule, and balance work between the office and home as it's best for you. We give you trust-based hours and a flexible smart working policy.
Teamwork makes the dream work. Our team has people from 3 different continents. We work in a multicultural environment where we can challenge and support each other.
We're building for the long term, and that means protecting our planet. We constantly test new green technologies and new opportunities, both physical and digital. We are a Brazilian / European footwear startup with headquarters in Lisbon preparing to sell globally. We started not so long ago (2021) and we are growing fast with many challenges and new market opportunities to unlock.
We believe that innovation and technology allied to sustainability is key to success in one of the most competitive markets on the planet. Our goal is to bring comfort and well being to our growing community.
Our journey has just begun. Are you ready to join us and help shape the future?
Undofortomorrow is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender (including pregnancy and gender identity), national, social or ethnic origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, competence and merit.

While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.

Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints. Help Center & Education Content

Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases. Marketing & Growth Design
Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently. Website & Conversion Optimization
Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind. Sales & Operations Enablement
Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed. Product Design Support
Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces. Asset Management & Brand Consistency
Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team. What We're Looking For
Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
Advanced or fluent English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications
Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience designing within a B2 B Saa S environment.
Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems. Nice-to-Have Skills
Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
Experience with Hub Spot (emails, templates, workflows).
Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.). Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Senior full-stack mobile engineer (react native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native i OS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.
Fly Me Out is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.
We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.
What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, Type Script, Tan Stack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/Type Script backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.
Day to day, you'll be working on things like:
Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with Type Script
Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction Compensation & Terms
This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.
Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)
Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)
Health benefits: Not offered at this stage
Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis
Probation: 2 weeks
Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil
How to Apply
Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Plm consultant | windchill | remote – brazil
description:
PLM Consultant | Windchill | Remote – Brazil
Estamos em busca de um PLM Consultant para atuar em projetos de consultoria e implementação utilizando a suíte PTC Windchill. Esse profissional será responsável por apoiar iniciativas de Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e contribuindo para a entrega de soluções eficientes para clientes globais.

• Apoiar projetos de consultoria e implementação de PLM utilizando PTC Windchill
• Analisar requisitos de negócio e colaborar na implementação de soluções junto a equipes técnicas e funcionais

• Contribuir para a definição de soluções técnicas e funcionais em ambientes PLM
• Apoiar atividades de planejamento, análise, desenvolvimento e testes dentro dos projetos

Requisitos:
• 2 a 5+ anos de experiência em PLM, preferencialmente com PTC Windchill
• Experiência em projetos de implementação de PLM
• Conhecimento em administração de sistemas, Windows Server e Linux (Red Hat)
• Experiência com Java, SQL ou Python
• Experiência com integrações utilizando Webservices, XML, JSON ou OData
• Conhecimento em Oracle ou SQL Server é um diferencial
• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas
Idiomas:
• Inglês avançado ou fluente (obrigatório)
• Espanhol é um diferencial
Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais.

Must have experience as a coordinator - booking events and travel
Must have strong reporting skills

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Desenvolvedor backend kotlin sr | aceitação pj
description:
Conheça melhor a unidade de negócio que essa vaga pertence:
A BU de Banking é especializada em oferecer soluções financeiras customizadas. Combinando expertise financeira com tecnologia avançada, visa facilitar operações diárias, otimizar a gestão financeira e apoiar o crescimento sustentável das empresas, garantindo sempre uma experiência segura, eficiente e personalizada.
Sobre a vaga:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora com experiência em Kotlin para integrar nosso time. Procuramos alguém com paixão por tecnologia, vontade de aprender e colaborar para construir soluções inovadoras que gerem impacto no negócio e na experiência de nossos clientes.
Responsabilidade e atribuições:
Tenha paixão por tecnologia e se mantenha atualizado(a) sobre as novidades do setor;
Goste de aprender e trabalhar com diferentes tecnologias e linguagens;
Participe ativamente das rotinas do time, propondo e discutindo soluções que atendam aos objetivos do negócio;
Tenha um olhar crítico e senso de dono sobre o que criamos no dia a dia;
Acompanhe e utilize métricas e indicadores do time para identificar e propor melhorias, sustentabilidade e novas oportunidades;
Colabore na criação e evolução dos fluxos de trabalho do time, garantindo eficácia e eficiência;
Desenvolva, coloque em produção, monitore e mantenha a saúde dos softwares e serviços entregues;
Melhore continuamente as bases de código, equilibrando velocidade de entrega e qualidade;
Realize e aceite feedbacks como parte de um ambiente colaborativo e voltado ao crescimento;
Assuma o protagonismo do seu autodesenvolvimento e da evolução da sua carreira profissional. Requisitos e qualificações:
Programação orientada a objetos;
Experiência com Java (21 ou 24)
Experiência com Kotlin;
Frameworks como Spring Boot, Spring Data, e uso de JPA;
Design de APIs REST;
Arquitetura de microsserviços;
Conhecimento em princípios como SOLID, Clean Code e padrões de projeto;
Experiência com CI/CD e ferramentas de automação;
Testes unitários e de integração;
Conhecimento em Docker e conteinerização;
Familiaridade com mensageria (ex.: Kafka, Rabbit MQ, SQS, SNS);
Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
Experiência com controle de versão usando Git;
Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em sistemas distribuídos (OAuth, JWT, etc.);
Experiência em processos de Code Review para garantir qualidade e boas práticas. O que oferecemos:
Saúde e Bem-estar
Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
Seguro de Vida;
Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;

Cartão de crédito Pic Pay Benefícios, com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho). Licença Paternidade e Maternidade:
Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
Programa \"Novo Ser\", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. title: Desenvolvedor rpa sênior – automation anywhere
description:
A Practia está presente em 9 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.
Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da Ui Path, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (Ui Path Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da Ui Path.
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor RPA Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico, integrando um time de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.
Essa pessoa atuará de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a revisão da documentação funcional, avaliação de complexidade, suporte ao design e arquitetura da solução, desenvolvimento das automações, sustentação, monitoramento, implantação em produção e apoio ao período de hypercare.
Além disso, será treinada em nosso framework proprietário e metodologia de Hyperautomação Smart BPA, que cobre toda a jornada — do Discovery à implementação do COE.
Como parte da equipe de Intelligent Automation, você colaborará com times multidisciplinares para entregar automações robustas, seguras, escaláveis e de alta qualidade.
O que buscamos
Profissional sênior, com forte experiência em desenvolvimento e sustentação de automações.
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e com visão de qualidade e governança.
Alguém que gosta de atuar em ambientes que valorizam competência, transparência e confiança.
Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente iniciativas, apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar membros do time. Responsabilidades
Revisar documentação funcional, apoiar estimativas e propor melhorias.
Desenvolver, implantar, monitorar e sustentar automações no Automation Anywhere A360.
Construir e manter componentes reutilizáveis, boas práticas e padrões internos.
Integrar automações com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços corporativos e soluções de Gen AI/ML e IDP.
Atuar em projetos de migração de versões, refactoring ou atualizações de arquitetura A360.
Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução garantindo performance, segurança e compliance.
Contribuir para o fortalecimento do framework e processos internos de automação.
Realizar troubleshooting, análise raiz de incidentes e melhorias de estabilidade.
Apoiar testes integrados, homologação e hypercare de novas entregas. Requisitos

title: Remote ai quality analyst (japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Key Qualifications:
Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description:
In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience:
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior quality assurance automation engineer
description:
Own your future
Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let's build something great together.
Must haves
Type Script proficiency (3+ years)
Proficiency with Playwright
Experience with Vitest or Jest
Experience with React Testing Library
Understanding of Page Object Model
Experience with REST/RPC API testing
Experience with Git and Git Hub Actions
Experience with monorepo architecture (PNPM workspaces, Turborepo)
SQL / database testing fundamentals
Upper-intermediate or advanced English, daily communication with US-team members Nice to have
Experience with t RPC
Drizzle ORM or similar Type Script ORM experience
Experience with microfrontend architecture

Contribute to the testing strategy across multiple solution packages in the monorepo
Work within an agile team alongside developers to ensure testability of new features from design phase

title: Junior data engineer – azure databricks / python / spark
description:
Role: Data Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term (Through Dec 2026)
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: 8am - 5pm CST
Location: 100% Remote
We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer with experience in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. Strong Python and SQL skills
Experience building ETL pipelines
Familiarity with Azure Data Factory and cloud data platforms Nice to have: Azure certifications, streaming data experience, or infrastructure-as-code knowledge.

title: Software engineer sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso " Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:
Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas O que nós estamos procurando:
Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

description:

Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets. Requirements:
3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus. What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry. Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus
Job type: Full Time
Responsabilidades:
Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat) e stablecoins, bem como atividades de VASP.
Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados. Requisitos:
Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial. O que oferecemos:
Salário e benefícios competitivos.
Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria. Qualificações Preferenciais:
Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial. Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral
Termos Técnicos: Mantive termos como Stablecoin, VASP, OTC, SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
Adaptação Cultural: O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.
