title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development
Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.
Location: Brazil
The Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M& A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M& A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.
The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M& A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.
Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M& A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M& A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M& A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M& A leadership to qualify M& A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units. Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M& A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M& A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency. Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Summary
We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.
Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.
This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.
Responsibilities
Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance Qualifications
2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier What We Offer
Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment

title: Gerente de operações financeiras (financial operations manager)
description:
Responsibilities:
Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards.
Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil.
Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed.
Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.g., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly.
Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning.
Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation.
Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards. Requirements:
3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus. What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry. Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus
Job type: Full Time Responsabilidades:
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais.
Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil.
Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário.
Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo.
Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.
Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos.
Utilizar efetivamente softwares de operações financeiras, ferramentas de custódia de cripto e dashboards. Requisitos:
Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
Familiaridade com relatórios financeiros brasileiros (SPED, Receita Federal, Banco Central) e conformidade fiscal (tax compliance).
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial. O que oferecemos:
Salário e benefícios competitivos.
Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

title: Wordpress plugin & full stack developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.
Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?
Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution: Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.
Defect Management: Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
Collaboration: Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.
Automation: Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines. Compensation
Salary: based on your experience level
To Apply Submit:
Current resume
Synopsis of recent salary history
If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview Requirements Before Employment
Signed Confidentiality agreement
Signed Non-compete agreement
Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form Company Culture
Remote
We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
Hours 8 AM - 5 PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.
Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!
About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.
We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities:

title: Customer success manager
description:
About Us
Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.
Job Overview
We're looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent, and a proactive approach to client engagement.
Key Responsibilities
Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.

Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, Saa S, or home services industries).

Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U. S.-based clients.
Tech-Savvy: Experience using Go High Level, Slack, and Click Up (or similar CRM and project management tools).
Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.

Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. Why Join Marketing Ninjas?
Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success. Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.
If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.
This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.
The impact you'll make:
Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.

Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence Technology Stack:
Go (Golang)
Blockchain What you'll bring to us:
5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.

Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, Ed DSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy working with us:
The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Search engine optimization manager
description:
About us:
At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.
Overview:
One of our fast-growing US clients is looking for a versatile SEO marketer with a strong Growth foundation and proven experience running B2 B campaigns. In this role, you'll own the search strategy, drive measurable pipeline growth, and support high-impact marketing initiatives across the funnel.
You'll spend about 60% of your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO) and 40% on broader growth projects. From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on Linked In and Google, you'll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.
This is a high-agency, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants room to grow.
Responsibilities:
Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.
Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments.
Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions.
Launch, manage, and optimize B2 B campaigns on Linked In Ads and Google Ads to drive qualified leads.
Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects. Skills & Qualifications:
5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2 B environments.
Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on Linked In Ads and Google Ads.
Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or equivalents.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong copywriting ability, especially for ads and landing pages.
High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast. Nice-to-Haves:
Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments.
Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or Tik Tok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.
The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.
Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and Tik Tok ads.
Responsibilities
Manage the Meta, Google, and/or Tik Tok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and Tik Tok
Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that. Compensation:
$2000 - $8000 USD per month Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or Chat GPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Business development manager – industrial market
description:
Hikvision is the world's largest supplier of video surveillance products and solutions. The company specializes in video surveillance technology, as well as designing and manufacturing a full line of innovative CCTV and video surveillance products. Since its establishment in 2001, Hikvision has quickly achieved a leading worldwide market position in the security industry.
Hikvision possesses the world's largest R& D team and state-of-art manufacturing facilities; both allow Hikvision's customers the benefit of world-class products that are designed with cutting-edge technology. The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.
Business Development Manager – Industrial Market
Country: Brazil
The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.
The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:
•Great business sense and market sense
•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market
•Great communication skills
•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred
•A positive attitude
•Great negotiation skills
•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity
Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:
•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys
•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points
•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users
•Presentation of the solution to potential customers
•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.
•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team
•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.
•Assist consultants to specify projects
•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.
•Prepare reports required by the management.
Your Profile:
•Experience in the industrial market.
•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.
•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.
•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.
•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred
•Strong communication skills in English,both oral and written
•Solid in Outlook and related products.

title: Sap s/4 hana application architect - product management (arquitecto de aplicaciones sap s/4 hana - gestión de productos) - end-user support/consultant
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
Primary Job Purpose
Responsible to support and assist in the design and implementation of the Supply Chain Operations template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by merging business and IT needs and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and utilization.
Work very closely with Lead Solution Architect – Sales & Operations to meet SAP implementation deliverables.
Key Position Accountabilities
Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP MM (Materials Management) and Variant Configuration related system configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
Lead and Support the Product Management Area in the SAP implementation project from solution and architecture perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
Facilitate and support Solution Architects, Workstream managers & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Material master data processes and integration of same with sales and Customer Service, finance & Operation workstreams.
Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. SELECTION CRITERIA
Essential:
Bachelor / Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support project experience in the area of material master data, data modelling, data governance in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with knowledge of integration across financial and logistics processes in SAP as a lead subject matter expert.
Hands on experience defining various types of Material master, Variant Configuration, Bill of Materials, Class & Characteristics and Object dependencies.
Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.
Should have solution design capabilities to reengineer business processes, sound knowledge of process modelling, ERP and packaged application fit/gap analysis, addressing critical business challenges typical to the industry or regional process nuances.
Understanding on SAP Best Practices and knowledge in Master data, MM module, their integrations & technology.
Ability to learn new tasks quickly; demonstrate flexibility when presented with change.
Lead and support a team environment.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline Desirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP MM.
Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4 HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
Health and Safety accountability statements.
Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in US/APC time zone as well for the need basis. We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Business development manager/director
description:
Ping Pong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300 B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world's leading cross-border platforms – and we're just getting started.
Ping Pong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.
Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.
WHAT' S THE CHALLENGE?
You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You'll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You've got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.
WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH
You'll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You'll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next. WHAT YOU BRING
Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams. WHO YOU ARE
Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
Customer-focused, you can't imagine working in any other way, and it's the only way to achieve our goals.
Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders Ping Pong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.
We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

Autonomia para estruturar e validar novas estratégias de crescimento;
Participação ativa na expansão da Velana;

Aqui, desenvolvimento de negócios significa criar novas possibilidades de crescimento, estruturar alianças estratégicas e impactar diretamente os resultados da empresa. Se você quer construir algo relevante e ter protagonismo real na expansão de uma fintech, essa vaga é para você.
Candidate-se e vamos crescer juntos!
100% Remoto | PJ | Bônus por performance

Registrar e acompanhar oportunidades no CRM;
Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de Vendas, Produto e Marketing para fortalecer a estratégia de expansão. Requisitos Essenciais
Experiência comprovada com gateways de pagamento, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
Vivência no ecossistema de fintechs, e-commerce, plataformas digitais ou Saa S;
Experiência em Business Development, parcerias estratégicas ou desenvolvimento de negócios;
Forte capacidade de relacionamento e construção de networking estratégico;
Boa comunicação e habilidade de negociação com decisores (CEOs, Founders, Heads);
Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a oportunidades.
Networking dentro do ecossistema de plataformas, produtores digitais e e-commerces;
Conhecimento em integrações de pagamento, APIs ou soluções financeiras digitais. O que Oferecemos

• Atuação direta no coração da operação da Velana;
• Ambiente ágil, colaborativo e sem burocracia;
• Contratação PJ | 100% remoto;
• Remuneração compatível com o nível do profissional
(com abertura para ajuste conforme senioridade e potencial de impacto);

Por que a Velana?
Na Velana, desenvolvimento de negócios não é só execução. Você terá espaço para pensar, testar e construir novas frentes que impactam diretamente o crescimento da empresa.
100% Remoto | PJ | Possibilidade de bônus por performance

title: Software application engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English
About Foretellix:
Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix's Foretify TM toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V& V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.
Role Description:
Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.
What will you do:
Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V& V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R& D. Understand the customer's V& V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings. Requirements:
At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
Have excellent human relationship skills
Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional. Advantages:
Experience in ADAS/AV V& V, testing, and simulation.
Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the 'e' language, and/or System Verilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Helbor Empreendimentos S. A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3, a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.
A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia. Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal. Informações adicionais

Vale Alimentação

Assistência Médica
Assistência odontológica
Participação nos Resultados

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Vaga Desenvolvedor API/Backend
Estamos buscando uma pessoa desenvolvedora backend com experiência em Python / Fast API para atuar no desenvolvimento de novas features e integrações de um Saa S de Inteligência Artificial.
Nosso produto é uma plataforma de Agentic AI, construída sobre Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e voltada para empresas que desejam escalar conversas automatizadas e integrar canais, pagamentos e agenda em um só lugar.
Sobre a Bren
A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do Whats App, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.
Responsabilidades
Evoluir o backend da plataforma (Fast API + Google Cloud)
Integrar sistemas de terceiros no app (ex: fornecedores e gateways de pagamento, calendário Google e Outlook)
Trabalhar em conjunto com o resto do time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura) Stack
Linguagem: Python
Framework: Fast API
Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
Principal API externa: Whats App Cloud API (Meta) Perfil Ideal
Experiência comprovada com APIs e integrações externas
Familiaridade com arquiteturas escaláveis e microserviços
Experiência com Google Cloud (ou AWS/Azure equivalente)
Conhecimento em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e queries de SQL
Experiência com API da Meta e Whatsapp Flow é um diferencial Modalidade
Trabalho remoto

title: Desenvolvedor servicenow | especialista técnico de aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):
O desenvolvedor Service Now fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do Service Now. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:
Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.
Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.
Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.
Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.
Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).
Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.
Integrar o APM com outros módulos do Service Now, incluindo ITSM e SAM.
Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.
Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.
Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.
Qualificações e Requisitos
Qualificações essenciais
• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada
• Certificação Service Now System Administrator (CSA)
• Certificação Service Now Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer
• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos
Competências-chave
8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI
Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e Java Script
Experiência na plataforma Service Now como Administrador e Desenvolvedor
Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB
Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração Service Now nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs
Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável
Outras habilidades e competências
Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão
Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Level designer / environment artist
description:
A Mobtex Softwares desenvolve softwares que trazem resultados reais para seus clientes, reduzindo custos, aumentando a produtividade dos recursos e inovando em variados segmentos de mercado. Atuamos com tecnologia, criatividade e visão de produto para construir soluções digitais e experiências interativas que geram impacto concreto.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Level Designer com forte sensibilidade visual, boa leitura da experiência do jogador e familiaridade com o novo normal do desenvolvimento de jogos com apoio de LLMs e ferramentas de IA.
Procuramos alguém que não apenas monte fases, mas que saiba transformar uma proposta de jogo em uma experiência bonita, clara, coerente e bem resolvida visualmente, usando com inteligência assets prontos, Blender, referências visuais e iteração rápida com times técnicos e criativos. O que esperamos desse perfil
Criar e estruturar fases, cenas e ambientes com boa leitura espacial, ritmo e composição visual
Trabalhar com graybox, layout, pacing, flow e organização da experiência do jogador
Utilizar Blender para montagem, ajustes, otimização e adaptação de assets e cenas
Saber integrar e combinar assets prontos com bom gosto, consistência estética e senso de direção visual
Colaborar com programadores, designers e equipes de produto para transformar documentos conceituais em experiências jogáveis
Usar LLMs e ferramentas de IA de forma prática no fluxo de trabalho: pesquisa, documentação, breakdown de tarefas, geração de variações, refinamento de ideias e aceleração de produção
Ter atenção a otimização de cena, organização de arquivos, reaproveitamento inteligente de recursos e eficiência de produção
Participar do refinamento visual e funcional das fases, elevando a qualidade final do jogo Requisitos
Experiência com level design, montagem de ambientes ou world building para jogos
Domínio prático de Blender para edição, adaptação, composição e otimização de assets e cenas
Boa noção de composição visual, escala, iluminação, leitura de cenário e clareza espacial
Capacidade de trabalhar com assets prontos e de marketplace sem deixar o resultado genérico ou inconsistente
Familiaridade com pipelines modernos de produção, incluindo uso de IA / LLMs como ferramenta de produtividade
Boa comunicação com equipes multidisciplinares
Perfil proativo, organizado e com atenção a acabamento Diferenciais
Experiência com Godot
Vivência com jogos educacionais, serious games ou experiências interativas com objetivos pedagógicos
Capacidade de criar props ou elementos 3 D simples quando necessário
Noção de direção de arte, environment art ou visual development
Experiência com otimização para projetos multiplataforma O que valorizamosValorizamos profissionais que entendam que desenvolver jogos hoje exige saber combinar visão criativa, repertório visual, ferramentas tradicionais e apoio inteligente de IA para produzir melhor, com mais velocidade, consistência e qualidade.
Buscamos alguém com bom senso estético, autonomia e vontade real de construir experiências que sejam ao mesmo tempo funcionais, bonitas e memoráveis.

title: Sdr - representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Remuneração Fixo + variável - PJ - Vaga Home Office
Estamos em busca de um SDR (Sales Development Representative) para integrar nossa equipe de forma remota, atuando no atendimento inicial de leads via Whats App e chamadas de vídeo. Se você tem habilidade em comunicação, é organizado e busca uma oportunidade com potencial de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a meritocracia, essa vaga é para você.
É imprescindível ter experiência prévia como SDR.
Habilidades e Qualidades Necessárias:
Excelente capacidade de comunicação e empatia para entender as necessidades dos leads.
Disciplina e organização para gerenciar múltiplos atendimentos de forma eficiente.
Ambição e foco em resultados para alcançar e superar objetivos.
Capacidade de aprendizado rápido para assimilar os processos e ferramentas da empresa.
Resiliência e proatividade frente aos desafios.
Ser uma pessoa extremamente focada em resultados.
Experiência anterior como SDR é obrigatória. Responsabilidades:
Receber e atender leads que chegam via Whats App de forma eficiente e acolhedora.
Coletar dados do lead, compreendendo suas necessidades e expectativas.
Realizar uma análise inicial para qualificar os leads de acordo com critérios estabelecidos.
Encaminhar os dados coletados e análises para o responsável, garantindo uma transição suave e eficaz.
Participar da conversa de Handoff com o closer. Oferecemos:
Uma oportunidade de carreira em uma empresa em crescimento.
Um ambiente de trabalho meritocrático, onde seu resultado é reconhecido.
Treinamento e desenvolvimento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades.
Remuneração fixa + variável e bônus.

title: Designer
description:
Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um Designer criativo para fazer parte da equipe da Padronanza Inteligência Empresarial. Neste cargo, você será responsável pela concepção, criação e entrega de materiais visuais e gráficos alinhados à identidade da marca e às necessidades dos clientes. Suas tarefas diárias incluirão a elaboração de layouts para mídias digitais e impressas, desenvolvimento de identidade visual, design de apresentações e colaboração com a equipe para garantir consistência estética e eficiência de comunicação. Este é um cargo de meio período e será desempenhado de forma totalmente remota.Qualificações
Design Gráfico e Ferramentas: Proeficiência em softwares de design como Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator e ferramentas de prototipagem como Figma ou similares é essencial.
Criação Visual: Capacidade de criar identidades visuais atrativas, layouts cativantes e materiais que traduzam conceitos em projetos visuais coerentes.
Comunicação: Habilidade de interpretar briefings e traduzir ideias complexas em soluções visuais claras e envolventes.
Diferenciais: Conhecimento em design UI/UX, criação de animações e vídeos e noções básicas de marketing digital serão considerados diferenciais relevantes.
